case_number: 2025 INSC 316; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(CRL.) NO(S). 11002-11009 OF 2024)
summary: Cheque dishonour under S.138 NI Act; security deposit refund; post-dated cheques issued; dishonoured due to insufficient funds; conviction upheld; compensation enhanced to Rs.9,00,000/-; no vacating of flat by respondent; rent non-payment for years; issue of legally enforceable debt; appeals below dismissed; High Court upheld; challenge to malicious prosecution; merger of rent and security deposit issues; S.138 liability distinct from tenancy dispute.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; conviction under S.138 NI Act set aside; no legally enforceable debt due to continued occupation without rent; compensation and fine set aside; respondent to vacate flat as per earlier ejectment decree.
